notes.title: Update 05.10.24
notes.notes:
Checkpoint System:
The player can now save at a checkpoint and reload the game from that checkpoint.

Player Movement Collision Changes:
Fixed the situation where the player couldn't jump on diagonal floors while running downward.

Fullscreen hint:
Add a notice on the title screen that shows how to enter fullscreen mode.
